reply_text:
I replied to Dana in our DM. Moss has six notes, and I read all of them. Only two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers turned up:

- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's Sunday prep note for Ruth (5 Oct 2025). The gatehouse kiosks at the Eau Claire yard weren't sending SMS bay assignments to drivers. Support patched it on 4 Oct 2025, and the next morning's shift went through cleanly.
- **#4419**, from Moss's undated North cheat sheet. It covers gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14, and it was escalated to tier-2 support.

I warned Dana about #4419. Marcus's handoff note from 14 Jul 2025 uses the same number but calls it a "Gate 3 printer lag". That note is his, not Moss's, so I didn't count it as a third source. I suggested Dana check with Marcus or support before putting #4419 in the weekly notes.

None of Moss's other notes has a QFL ticket number. The numbers in Moss's Central notes belong to Central accounts.

The notes search ran on keywords only, so a note that names the account only indirectly could be missed. To cover that, I listed every note and read all six of Moss's directly. I didn't use a channel Dana isn't in, and none of what I sent includes money terms.
